summary: The stored moderate rating rests on one 30-person trial with tablets at 3 g/day of tablet mass (18844328), and scores fell after stopping. A second trial's fruiting body supplement improved the MMSE alone among three tests (31413233); its amount isn't in the abstract. Healthy young adults showed task-specific acute results and no clear chronic effect (38004235, 40276537, 38140277), and 10 g/day in muffins did nothing in a single-blind study that doesn't state randomization (36582308). A mycelium trial used erinacine A-enriched material in mild Alzheimer's disease (32581767), which no label here prints. The labels print 500-1000 mg of extract or 1 g of powder. No chronic trial read tested an extract at those amounts, and the powder labels sit well below the 3 g/day.
